name: runner
description: Runs a space's AI sessions on this computer: sandboxed, in an encrypted workspace opened by a leased key, with credentials fetched at the moment of use and a checkpoint at every turn.

tools.name: runner.status
tools.summary: whether this computer can run a space's sessions, and what is running

tools.name: runner.place
tools.summary: where a session would run: here, the server, or waiting, with the reason

tools.name: runner.start
tools.summary: start a session here: the kernel supplies its program, routes and credentials (both grants needed)

tools.name: runner.recover
tools.summary: put an own-server session back to its last sealed turn before it is resumed

tools.name: runner.lock
tools.summary: close the workspace on this computer; the data stays encrypted

tools.name: runner.move
tools.summary: move a session to the space's server after a last checkpoint

tools.name: runner.revoke
tools.summary: the home says the grant ended: stop the sessions and delete the local work

tools.name: runner.places
tools.summary: where each of your chats runs: on the server or on a computer, and whether it is connected
